case_evidence.description: Published frozen Python typed FunctionalMixedEffectsResult covariance decomposition: optional source model label and five ordered variance/covariance component types in pandas table, represented as R native data.frame.

Fitted-source-shaped finite time, basis, intercept/slope/cross covariance, optional functional trial-intercept covariance and residual variance; no re-fitting and no claim of moments-vs-likelihood estimator parity.

Identical timewise B C B^T quadratic forms, signed intercept-slope cross covariance, optional functional trial variance and repeated residual variance; fully ordered component/type/time/value columns.

Malformed basis/covariance dimensions, absent required intercept-slope cross covariance, absent functional trial covariance and invalid empty label rejected; other trial types omitted rather than incorrectly rejected.

Python pandas source table mapped to R data.frame with identical five column names, source component-major row ordering and complete numerical values for full, nonfunctional-trial and intercept-only variants.
Descriptive source fitted random-effect covariance component functions, not proportions, covariance model selection, statistical tests or evidence of upstream estimator numerical equivalence.
